title: Php: Use-after-free via repopulation of last_fatal_error_backtrace global after shutdown (CVE-2026-129182)
description: A use-after-free vulnerability exists in PHP versions 8.5.0 through 8.5.12 due to repopulation of the last_fatal_error_backtrace global after request shutdown. This occurs when a fatal error is raised during restoration of modified INI settings, causing memory corruption and potential worker crashes. The flaw may allow remote code execution under certain configuration conditions. The issue is fixed in PHP 8.5.13.
